cohort_size: 216 independent decisions: 3 models x 6 seeds x 4 turns x 3 conditions
purpose: Frozen paper cohort for ToolRoute dynamic telemetry evaluation across GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Sonnet 5, and Gemini 3.7 Flash.

provider_parameters.request_retry_policy: no retry; every submitted request is retained in paper denominator

b_control.construction: same fixed telemetry envelope, field names, ordering, and tool rows as C; tool_alpha and tool_beta have identical neutral values
b_control.token_usage: provider-reported input-token usage retained descriptively; no padding or count-token request

inclusion_exclusion: Every submitted request remains in the paper denominator; malformed and provider-error records are retained and reported separately; no retries.
analysis_and_power_plan: Primary contrast: C–A policy regret and completion rate. Secondary contrasts: C–B (epistemic treatment effect) and B–A (attention tax). Wilson intervals for binary completion; non-parametric permutation and rank tests for regret and latency.
